minimum_version.command: PYTHONPATH="$PWD" OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 python -m pytest -q tests/test_cg_tolerances.py tests/test_block_products_experimental.py

focused.scope: CG tolerance, batched CG, block products, experimental LOBPCG

lint: ruff check warpack tests benchmarks examples: passed
format: ruff format --check warpack tests benchmarks/experimental benchmarks/monitor_gpu.py: passed
production_scope: Explicit CGInverse.adaptive_capture opt-in for preallocated upstream loop control; default stays fixed. No upstream CG arithmetic change.
experimental_scope: Adaptive batched upstream CG; shared scalar sparse block products; implicit identity mass in Hodge driver.
upstream_scope: Not a full upstream CuPy/Spectra conformance rerun.
performance: Sequential uncontended Anvil and Hodge runs; separate occupancy and per-trial accuracy records. Setup and capture separate from warm solve.
